note: Curated list of things I am building from scratch. Edit freely; the page enriches each entry with live GitHub activity when it can.

projects.name: cpore
projects.blurb: A Spore-like life simulation written from scratch in C, built as a reinforcement-learning environment rather than a game. Own renderer, own PNG codec — libc and libm only.

projects.name: learn-stuff-from-scratch
projects.blurb: From-scratch implementations with graded checks — AWS, compilers, LLMs, Dynamo, context caching. The material behind /learn.

projects.name: mus-benchmark
projects.blurb: Multi-agent experiments on the Spanish card game mus: covert signalling, órdago decisions, and LLMs playing against each other.

projects.name: bayesian-llm-council
projects.blurb: Bayesian aggregation across several LLMs voting on an answer, so disagreement is measured instead of averaged away.

projects.name: litetorch
projects.blurb: PyTorch reimplemented small enough to read, with reinforcement-learning algorithms included.

projects.name: robellm
projects.blurb: Re-aligning a Robe Iniesta persona LoRA with an editor-in-the-loop DPO: a model rectifies its own drafts into preference pairs.

projects.name: regllm
projects.blurb: Answering questions about Spanish banking regulation with a grounded LLM.

projects.name: deep_learning_in_c
projects.blurb: A neural network from scratch in C: backprop and gradient descent at the lowest level.

projects.name: labelled
projects.blurb: Platform for decentralised data labelling, currently supporting multiclass annotations.

projects.name: dec-inference
projects.blurb: Decentralised inference: serving models across shared compute.
